blocks.text: ⁧مُحَمَّد⁩ you can find written Muḥammad, Muhammad, Mohammed, Mohammad, Mohamed; ⁧يُوسُف⁩ becomes Yusuf, Youssef, Yousef, Youcef. They are not mistakes: every country and every European language has its own habits, and none is official for all. In this unit you learn the most common Latin spellings (English, French, Egyptian), their reasons, and above all the method of going back from Latin to Arabic: what Arabic letters can be behind a Latin letter, where are the ambiguities, when you have to ask. You also learn to spell a name in Arabic. A week.
